title: Even though this is large, it did Not meet my expectations...
text:
Even though this is large, it did Not meet my expectations.... [[VIDEOID:69364c3f00a547b005aa777086f537e3]] I was pretty excited for this, but after receiving it I was disappointed. The manual is poorly written in English. But, the griddle itself seems very thin. I’m not a huge fan of the underneath steel tray. The stripe area is just wasted space. It cooks basically the same, but I find that I don’t like to cook certain items on this because the stripes kinda get in the way of some cooking items that you use a griddle for.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)

product_metadata.title: Indoor Grill Smokeless Electric Grill, 1500W 19x11" BBQ Grill with Non-Stick Surface, 170℉-480℉Temperature Control
features: 【Non stick heating plate】480x280mm / 19x11in electric baking plate, can barbecue food for 5-10 people, it has non stick coating, does not need to put a lot of oil, cleaning is also very convenient.

【Two in one barbecue plate】 Honeycomb plate and stripe plate can provide you with a variety of barbecue options. Honeycomb plate is perfect for pancakes and eggs. Stripe plate is suitable for drumsticks, seafood, bacon, steak, etc.
【Fast and uniform heating】Power 1500W, 5-temperature (170℉-480℉) can be adjusted, you can control your barbecue and cooking, fast heating without long waiting.

【Less smoke】Too much fat sticks to the baking plate, and it will smoke after meeting high temperature. In order to achieve a completely smoke-free indoor barbecue, you can add water properly during the barbecue process, so that the smoke generated in the barbecue will be less, and you don't have to worry about the smoke smell will pollute your home.
